assets.name: DEAD DROP
assets.prompt:
Use the attached image as the existing GH0ST brand source. Transform it into ONE standalone product logo lockup. Deliver a perfectly square 1:1 canvas (about 1024x1024) with a pure matte black background. Replace the branching scene with a single centered, immediately recognizable product emblem in the upper-middle area. Keep GH0ST's exact identity language: angular inward-facing square brackets, two ivory vertical eye strokes and one short ivory horizontal dash for the mouth. Build the entire emblem from small perfectly circular LED matrix dots on a disciplined grid, not solid vector lines. Amber #EAC18A and warm ivory #F4EDE1 only; very restrained pinhole luminance, crisp flat printed-dot precision. Maintain a coherent family layout: emblem about 45% of canvas width, occupying roughly y=24%-63%; centered small amber monospaced 'GH0ST' at y=77%; centered large ivory monospaced PRODUCT NAME at y=83%, generous black margins. The product name must be exactly as specified. No other words or numbers. This is an identity logo, with extremely simple geometry and lots of negative space; no surrounding UI, poster border, gradients, starfields, glow fog, photographic textures, 3D, coins, mascots with bodies, watermarks, mockups, dates or URL. Each output must be ONE distinct finished logo, not a grid.
PRODUCT NAME: "DEAD DROP".
Specific emblem: One sealed angular envelope whose upper fold and central hanging amber dot together imply a message waiting to be released. Integrate the canonical GH0ST bracket-face on the envelope's front, with the two ivory vertical eyes and short ivory horizontal dash mouth. The envelope reads immediately as the outer silhouette.

assets.name: GH0ST PROTOCOL ROADMAP
assets.prompt:
Using the attached GH0ST brand artwork as the stylistic source, create a polished official GH0ST protocol roadmap infographic. A landscape 16:9 canvas around 2048x1152, pure matte black, warm amber #EAC18A and ivory #F4EDE1 only. Restrained precise round LED dots on a regular matrix for every icon, connector and checkmark. Clean monospaced editorial lettering, crisp, clear hierarchy, generous black spacing. No photos, 3D, glow fog, gradients, coins, finance charts, decorative starfields or rainbow colours.
Top header: small canonical GH0ST bracket-face glyph, then 'GH0ST PROTOCOL' above a large 'ROADMAP'. Small upper right '04 NOV 2026'. Thin amber dotted divider below. Main layout is a left lane (about 36% width) of SIX completed foundations and a right lane (about 59%) containing EIGHT planned protocol cards in a disciplined two-column four-row grid. Use a small dotted directional connector between the two lane headings to imply future expansion. No phase numbers or release dates.
LEFT HEADING 'BUILT'. Each of these six completed items has a real amber CHECKMARK at left and an ivory product name with one small ivory descriptor below. Exactly:
'ICP AI CORE' / 'EVM checks + Qwen notes'
'WHISPERS' / 'Buy-triggered onchain thoughts'
'WATCHER' / 'Robinhood contract evidence'
'SHARED SCANS' / 'Reusable public reports'
'SPAWN A GH0ST' / 'Project agents + activity feeds'
'AGENTKIT PREVIEW' / 'Developer SDK + interface'
RIGHT HEADING 'PLANNED'. Exactly these eight cards, all marked with a HOLLOW amber circle and a small clear distinct dotted icon. None has a checkmark. The name and one short descriptor are exactly:
'DEAD DROP' / 'Conditional message release' / icon envelope with GH0ST face
'BOUNTIES' / 'Tasks with escrowed rewards' / icon target brackets with face
'MEMORY' / 'Portable agent memory' / icon layered bracket frames
'JURY' / 'Independent agent decisions' / icon three small faces
'INTENT ESCROW' / 'Pay for verified outcomes' / icon clasped vault brackets
'PASSPORT' / 'Agent identity + reputation' / icon identity pass with face
'EXPERIMENTS' / 'Fund reproducible studies' / icon flask containing face
'WORLDS' / 'Persistent characters + memories' / icon globe containing face
Small footer 'gh0st.fyi' left; 'Planned modules · release dates to be set' right.
Render all wording verbatim, no extra labels or slogans. Names should be noticeably larger than descriptors, but every descriptor must remain readable when shared online. The six checkmarks mean complete existing capabilities; the eight empty circles mean future products. Keep these exact statuses and all fourteen unique items with no duplicates. Draw inspiration from the attached reference's graphic density, precise amber dots, square-bracket faces and flat warm-ivory features. Adapt into this information-rich layout instead of copying the branching scene.

upcoming.name: Upcoming protocols infographic
upcoming.prompt:
Edit the provided official GH0ST roadmap artwork into a NEW dedicated infographic explaining ONLY its eight upcoming protocol concepts. Preserve exactly the crisp ivory and warm amber circular LED dot-matrix brand style on pure black, the angular bracket faces, understated light, monospaced typography, no gradients or 3D. Replace the prior landscape layout with a generous portrait 4:5 canvas, suitable as a high-resolution X infographic (aim 1536x1920). Remove the BUILT list entirely. This is a complete layout redesign using the same brand.
Top header includes one small GH0ST bracket-face, 'GH0ST PROTOCOL' in small ivory uppercase, then large amber title 'WHAT COMES NEXT'. Under it use small ivory 'EIGHT PLANNED PROTOCOLS'. Main body is a clean two-column by four-row grid with generous margins, faint dotted separators and a distinct amber dot-matrix emblem above the title in each cell. No filled checkmarks anywhere. Place one small hollow amber status circle with each title.
Exactly these eight cells, read left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
1 DEAD DROP — icon sealed envelope containing bracket-face. Description exactly 'Messages that unlock when conditions are met.'
2 BOUNTIES — icon target corners and bracket-face. Description exactly 'Fund tasks. Reward verified work.'
3 MEMORY — icon three layered bracket frames. Description exactly 'Carry agent knowledge across applications.'
4 JURY — icon three bracket-faces joined on one line. Description exactly 'Independent agents review and resolve.'
5 INTENT ESCROW — icon vault brackets with a clasp. Description exactly 'Release payment when outcomes are verified.'
6 PASSPORT — icon identity pass containing face. Description exactly 'Portable identity, permissions and reputation.'
7 EXPERIMENTS — icon flask containing face and one suspended dot. Description exactly 'Fund hypotheses. Publish reproducible results.'
8 WORLDS — icon globe containing face with one orbit. Description exactly 'Persistent characters with shared memories.'
Set all product names uppercase in crisp ivory monospace, large enough to be legible on mobile. The explanatory sentences should be readable and wrap naturally to two or three lines in warm ivory; use standard letter O in product words and a numeral zero only in GH0ST. Footer small 'gh0st.fyi' and 'Planned · release dates to be set'. Each of eight identities exactly once. No dates, no phase numbers, no marketing claims, no text other than specified. Beautiful rigorous alignment, usable negative space, accurate wording over decorative complexity.
